description: Figure 7 illustrates the relationship between the number of samples and the accuracy for several models. The x-axis is labeled “Number of Samples” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.1 to 1.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. There are four lines displayed: a solid blue line with circle markers, a solid orange line with square markers, a dashed green line with diamond markers, and a dashed red line with triangle markers. The blue line begins at approximately 0.15 at a sample number of 0.1 and increases to approximately 0.98 at a sample number of 1.0. The orange line starts at approximately 0.25 at a sample number of 0.1 and increases to approximately 0.99 at a sample number of 1.0. The green line begins at approximately 0.35 at a sample number of 0.1 and increases to approximately 0.99 at a sample number of 1.0. The red line starts at approximately 0.45 at a sample number of 0.1 and increases to approximately 0.99 at a sample number of 1.0.
